<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex76012024-09-1612-39-18" status="finalized" ana="corpusmd:colophon"><milestone unit="section" n="Colophon (97a2-97a5)"/>
				<rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:5209"><rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3715">dbu ma'i rtsa ba'i tshig le'ur byas pa shes rab</rs> ces bya ba'i rgya cher bshad pa ¦ tshig don rab tu gsal ba</rs> zhes <lb n="97a3"/> bya ba ¦ gsung rab kyi de kho na nyid thugs su chung nas ¦ 'chad brtsod brtsom pa la snang ba rab tu rgyas pa'i ¦ <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4593">sde snod 'dzin pa nyi ma seng ge</rs> dang ¦ <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4593">dpal gsang pa 'dus pa</rs> dang ¦ mtha' bral dbu ma chen po sogs ¦ <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3720">'phags pa klu sgrub</rs> yab sras kyi gzhung lugs la gzhan gyis brdzi bar mi nus pa'i spobs pa <note type="editorial">spobs is unclear.</note> dge ba can pa <lb n="97a4"/> <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4593">yong dbon po shAkya seng ge</rs> dang ¦ lung dang rigs pa'i de kho na nyid phyin ci ma log par smra zhing || chos tshul 'dis la mi phyed pa'i dad pa can | <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4091">mdo stod pa <expan>sangs rgyas</expan> 'bum</rs><!--maybe dbus pa blo gsal db:4091--> <expan>la sogs</expan> pas bskul nas ¦ <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4080">shAkya'i dge slong skyabs mchog dpal bzang po</rs>s ¦ <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3725">dpal ldan zla ba grags pa</rs>'i 'grel ba bzhin du ¦ dbang <expan>phyug gi</expan> lo ¦ smin drug can gyi <lb n="97a5"/> zla ba'i dkar phyogs kyi tshes bcu gsum la sbyar ba'o || 
				<expan>yi ge</expan> pa ni <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:6844">lung dang rigs par smra ba ¦ seng ge rgyal mtshan</rs> gyis <expan>bgyis so</expan> || 
				'di la <expan>brten nas</expan> <expan>sangs rgyas</expan> kyi bstan pa rin po che phyogs dang dus dang gnas skabs <expan>thams cad</expan> du dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas par gyur cig |</seg></TEI>
